name: How You Should Dress
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor God in their outward appearance by avoiding practices that defile the body, such as marking the flesh or adopting clothing that blurs the distinctions God has established between men and women. The Bible warns against dressing in a way that promotes immorality or draws praise for physical beauty alone, emphasizing instead the value of a woman who fears the Lord. Ultimately, believers are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, reflecting a heart devoted to Him rather than conforming to worldly standards of dress.
